package migrated

import (
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/datatable"
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/http"
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/httpclient/capture"
	webhook "github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/webhook/capture"
)

func mounts() {
	var scope http.Scope
	var store *capture.Store
	var hooks *webhook.Store
	_ = datatable.ReadAccess(http.Scopes(read), http.Permissions(viewer))
	_ = datatable.ExportAccess(http.AnyOf(http.AllOf(http.Permissions(editor))))
	_ = capture.Routes(scope, store, users, http.Scopes(read), http.Permissions(viewer))
	_ = webhook.Routes(scope, hooks, users, http.Permissions(viewer))
}
